issues.title: Interested in becoming an implementation partner
issues.body:
Hi team,

We are a 40-person consultancy based in Rotterdam. Most of our clients are mid-sized logistics and freight companies, and over the last year we have rolled out the app for six of them (mostly agents for customs paperwork and a few workflows that feed their transport management systems).

We would like to talk about a formal partnership: referral terms, access to a sandbox workspace for demos, and maybe a listing on your partner page if you have one. Nothing is broken on our side, this is purely a business conversation.

Who is the right person to contact? Happy to set up a call any time next week.

Best,
Maarten

issues.title: Add an approval step that pauses a workflow until someone signs off
issues.body:
### What would you like?

A workflow step type 'Approval' that stops the run and waits until a named person or group approves or rejects. On approve the run continues with the next step, on reject it ends (or goes to a separate branch). Ideally the approver gets a notification with the data the previous step produced, and can edit it before approving.

### Why

We use a workflow that drafts replies to supplier complaints and sends them by email. Right now we either let it send automatically (too risky for some customers) or we split it into two workflows and copy the draft by hand between them. An approval step would let us keep one workflow and still have a human check before anything leaves the company.

A timeout setting (e.g. auto-reject after 48h) would also be useful.

issues.title: Which Google Drive permissions does the connector ask for?
issues.body:
Our security team has to sign off before we enable the Google Drive integration for the whole company (about 1,200 Google Workspace users).

Two questions came up:

1. When a user connects their Drive, can the app read every file that user has access to, or only the files and folders they pick in the file picker?
2. Can we as admins limit the connector to shared drives only, so personal My Drive content is never touched?

If there is a page that lists the exact OAuth scopes and what is stored on your side (file contents, only embeddings, metadata?), a link would be enough. We could not find it in the help center.

Thanks

issues.title: Scanned PDFs stay at 'Indexing...' forever in the library
issues.body:
### What happened?

We uploaded 14 scanned contracts (image-only PDFs, 20 to 80 pages each) to our 'Contracts 2025' collection. All of them have been showing 'Indexing...' for three days now. There is no error message and no progress percentage.

PDFs exported from Word index within a minute in the same collection, so it seems to be only scans without a text layer.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a collection
2. Upload a scanned PDF without OCR text (I can share a sample privately)
3. Wait

### Expected behavior

The file is either indexed (with OCR) or marked as failed with a reason.

### Workaround

Running the files through OCR on our side first and re-uploading works, but that is a manual step for every contract.

### Version / environment

Web app, Chrome 145, EU region workspace.

issues.title: Mid-cycle upgrade billed at the full monthly price instead of prorated
issues.body:
Hello billing team,

We moved from the Team plan to the Business plan on March 10, in the middle of our billing period (our cycle starts on the 1st). The invoice we received on March 11 (INV-2026-03-04417) charges the full Business price for 25 seats for all of March, while the Team plan for March was already paid on March 1. There is no credit line for the unused Team days.

Your pricing page says plan changes are prorated. Could you check the invoice and refund or credit the difference? We pay by card, the card is already on file with you.

Thanks,
Priya (finance, Northgate Analytics)

issues.title: Every agent run fails with 502 upstream connect error
issues.body:
### What happened?

Since about 07:50 UTC today every agent run in our workspace fails after 3-5 seconds. The run panel shows:

```
Run failed: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination (502)
```

This is all 23 of our agents, including a brand-new test agent with no tools and no knowledge attached. Plain chat (no agent) still works. Everything worked fine yesterday evening.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open any agent
2. Send 'hello'
3. Run fails with the error above

### Impact

Our customer service desk runs on two of these agents, so the team is currently unable to work. We have no workaround.

### Version / environment

Web app, multiple browsers and networks. Workspace id ws_7f31c2.

issues.title: IT helpdesk agent just says 'Something went wrong'
issues.body:
My helpdesk agent stopped answering this morning. I type a question, it shows 'Thinking...' for a moment and then a red box: 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.' Retrying gives the same thing every time.

I opened the browser dev tools like our IT guy asked and the request POST /api/agents/runs comes back with status 502. My colleagues in Finance have the same problem with their expense agent, so it is not only me.

What is strange is that normal chat without an agent works fine, so I don't think it is our network.

We are using this agent for all first-level IT questions in the company, so people are now emailing me directly. Please help.

issues.title: Is there a context limit per model, and can I see it?
issues.body:
In long chats (100+ messages, a lot of pasted logs) the assistant seems to forget what we agreed at the start. For example it asks again for the server name I gave it in the first message.

I assume this is the model's context window and older messages fall out. Is that right? A few questions:

- Is there a documented limit per model in the model picker?
- Does the app summarize older messages or simply drop them?
- Is there any indicator in the UI that tells me when I am close to the limit?

Not complaining, just want to understand it so I can tell my team when to start a new chat.

issues.title: Attaching .docx files to a chat fails with 'Unsupported file type' since last week
issues.body:
### What happened?

Since the release last Tuesday, attaching a Word document to a chat message fails immediately with:

```
Unsupported file type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
```

This worked until last week; I attached .docx files almost every day. PDF, TXT and PNG still attach fine.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start a new chat
2. Click the paperclip and pick any .docx (tried 5 different files, 30 KB to 4 MB)
3. Error toast appears, file is not attached

### Expected behavior

.docx attaches like before.

### Workaround

Saving the document as PDF first and attaching that works, so I am not blocked, just annoyed.

### Version / environment

Edge on Windows 11, also reproduced in Firefox.

issues.title: On-premises edition for an air-gapped network
issues.body:
### What would you like?

An installable edition of the app (Docker images or a Helm chart) that we can run in our own data center, fully offline, with no calls to your cloud.

### Why

We are a defense supplier. Part of our engineering department works in an air-gapped network and cannot use any SaaS. They would like the same agents and knowledge library the rest of the company already uses in our cloud workspace. We would host our own models on that network.

We would be willing to pay for a separate license and handle the updates ourselves. Is this something on your roadmap?

issues.title: Let an agent call another agent as a tool
issues.body:
### What would you like?

In the agent builder, allow adding an existing agent as a tool of another agent. The parent agent would send it a task and get back the final answer (not the whole transcript).

### Why

We have a 'Contract reviewer' agent and a 'Pricing checker' agent that each work well on their own, with their own instructions and knowledge collections. Our sales team now wants one 'Deal desk' agent that uses both. Today the only option is to copy both sets of instructions and tools into one big agent, which gets confusing and means maintaining everything twice.

Nice to have: a limit on how deep the nesting can go, and the sub-agent runs visible in the run log.

issues.title: Okta SSO users stuck in a redirect loop after today's release
issues.body:
### What happened?

Since this morning nobody who signs in through Okta (SAML) can get into the workspace. After authenticating in Okta the browser goes to /sso/saml/callback, then /login, then straight back to Okta, and around again until the browser gives up.

Only our two break-glass admins with password login can get in. That is 640 users blocked.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the workspace URL
2. Click 'Sign in with SSO'
3. Authenticate in Okta
4. Loop

### What we checked

- Nothing changed in Okta, the app config there is from 2025
- SAML tracer shows a valid, signed assertion with the right NameID
- The callback response does not seem to set the session cookie at all

### Expected behavior

Users land in the workspace like yesterday. This started right after release 2026.04.2 went out.

issues.title: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS when logging in with company account
issues.body:
Hi, we cannot log in since yesterday evening.

I click the company login button, I get our normal Okta page with the push notification, I approve it, and then the browser shows:

```
This page isn't working
app redirected you too many times.
ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS
```

I tried Chrome and Edge, incognito, cleared cookies. Same result. My whole department (procurement, about 30 people) has the same problem and from what I hear other departments too. Our IT says Okta is fine and other apps work.

We have a supplier deadline today and the agents we need are in the app. Is there an outage?

issues.title: Does connecting Google Drive give access to everyone's My Drive?
issues.body:
Before we roll out the Drive connector our data protection officer wants a written answer to this:

When an employee connects their Google account, which OAuth scopes does the app request? Is it the full drive.readonly scope (so every file the person can see) or drive.file (only files they explicitly choose)? And is there an admin setting that keeps the connector away from personal My Drive folders and allows only selected shared drives?

We are a German company so we also need to know where file contents are stored after the sync.

Nothing is broken, we just have not enabled it yet because of this.

issues.title: Slack bot posts every agent answer twice in channels
issues.body:
### What happened?

Since Friday (April 17) our Slack integration posts each agent reply twice in #support-triage, 2-4 seconds apart, identical text. When someone mentions the bot in a thread, both copies land in the thread.

Direct messages to the bot are fine, only one reply. Nothing changed on our side; it worked for months before that.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add the bot to a public channel
2. Mention it with any question
3. Two identical replies appear

### Impact

Only our support team (12 people) uses the bot in channels. It is not blocking, but people react to the wrong copy and the emoji-based triage we built on top of it counts everything twice.

Slack app reinstalled once already, no change.

issues.title: Show the page number in library citations
issues.body:
### What would you like?

When an answer cites a document from a knowledge library collection, show the page number (or page range) next to the file name, and open the PDF at that page when I click it.

### Why

Our compliance team uses collections with handbooks that are 300+ pages long. The citation currently shows the file name and a short snippet, and people end up searching the PDF for the snippet text to verify the answer. With a page number they could check a source in seconds.

This is a small thing but it would make the answers a lot easier to trust.

issues.title: Conversations older than two weeks are gone for our marketing team
issues.body:
### What happened?

This morning 11 people in our marketing team found that all their chats from before roughly April 15 are missing from the sidebar. Searching by title still finds some of them, but clicking a result shows 'Conversation not found'. A few others open but only contain the first message, everything after it is gone.

These chats had campaign briefs and copy drafts we worked on for weeks. Nobody deleted anything and no retention policy is set in admin settings (we checked: 'Keep forever').

Users in other teams seem unaffected so far.

### Expected behavior

All saved conversations are still there.

### What we need

Please restore the data from a backup if possible, and tell us what happened. Could this hit other teams too?

Workspace: ws_a19e04, EU region.

issues.title: How do I share an agent with one group only?
issues.body:
I built an agent for our claims department that has access to the 'Claims procedures' collection. Before we roll it out I want only the Claims group (synced from Entra ID, 48 people) to see it in the agent list.

In the share dialog I can search for individual people, and there is a toggle 'Available to everyone in the workspace'. I cannot find a way to pick a group. Do I have to add all 48 people one by one, and then again every time someone joins? Or is there a group option somewhere else, e.g. in admin settings?

We want to go live next Monday, so a quick pointer would be great.

issues.title: Invoices collection stuck on 'Processing', agent can't find anything
issues.body:
Our accounts payable agent is supposed to answer questions about supplier invoices from the 'Supplier invoices' collection. It keeps answering 'I could not find any information about this in the library.'

When I open the collection, 63 of the 71 files have the status 'Processing' since last Monday. The 8 that work are invoices suppliers sent as normal PDFs. The 63 stuck ones all come from the scanner on our office printer, saved as PDF.

I deleted 5 of them and uploaded again, same thing, they go back to 'Processing' and stay there. No error anywhere.

Is there a size limit or a problem with scanned files? We need this working for month-end closing.

issues.title: Stream audit logs to our SIEM
issues.body:
### What would you like?

A way to send the workspace audit log to an external system continuously: a syslog or HTTPS endpoint, a webhook per event, or at least a scheduled export to an S3 bucket. We use Splunk.

### Why

Our SOC requires all SaaS audit events (logins, SSO config changes, role changes, API key creation, data exports) to land in the SIEM within 15 minutes. Right now the only option is downloading a CSV from Admin > Audit log by hand, which only covers 90 days and nobody remembers to do it.

This is a requirement in our vendor security review, and our renewal is in September.

issues.title: All API keys return 401 invalid_api_key, including newly created ones
issues.body:
### What happened?

Since 05:58 UTC every request from our backend to the public API fails:

```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"The API key provided is not valid."}}
```

This is all 4 keys in the workspace. I created a new key in Settings > API keys ten minutes ago and it fails the same way. The keys show as Active in the UI and nothing was rotated on our side.

### Steps to reproduce

```
curl https://api.<our-region>/v1/agents -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...'
```

### Impact

The chat widget on our customer portal runs through the API, so it has been down for all our end customers for over an hour. No workaround.

### Expected behavior

Valid keys authenticate as they did until this morning.

issues.title: Do API keys expire, and can we rotate them without downtime?
issues.body:
Our security policy requires rotating machine credentials every 90 days. Before we put the API into production I would like to understand how keys work:

- Do keys have an expiry date, or are they valid until revoked?
- Can we set an expiry when creating a key?
- Can two keys be active at the same time, so we can deploy the new one before revoking the old one?
- Is there an API endpoint to create and revoke keys, or is it UI only?

We are not seeing any errors, this is just for planning.

issues.title: Human sign-off before a workflow continues
issues.body:
### What would you like?

Our legal team only agreed to the contract-summary workflow under one condition: a lawyer has to look at the generated summary before it is written to the opportunity in Salesforce.

Could a workflow stop at a certain point and wait until someone clicks 'OK' (in the app, or even better in Microsoft Teams), and then continue with the remaining steps? If the lawyer says no, the run should stop and not write anything.

### Why

Today we have to run the workflow up to the summary step, then a person copies the summary into Salesforce manually. That defeats most of the point of automating it.

issues.title: Please re-issue the May invoice with our VAT number and new address
issues.body:
Hello,

Our May invoice (INV-2026-05-11872) was issued without our VAT ID and still shows our old office address. Our accounting cannot book it like this.

Correct details:
Company: Boreal Logistique SAS
Address: 14 rue des Tanneurs, 69007 Lyon, France
VAT ID: FR XX 123456789 (I updated it in the billing settings today as well)

Could you send a corrected invoice and make sure future invoices use these details? No change to the plan or payment method.

Thank you,
Claire

issues.title: Answers from our custom OpenAI-compatible model stop at about 4k tokens
issues.body:
### What happened?

We connected our own model through 'Custom model > OpenAI-compatible endpoint'. Long answers (reports, code files) always stop mid-sentence at around 4,000 tokens. The model supports 32k output and in the model config we set 'Max output tokens' to 16000.

Our gateway logs show the app sends `max_tokens: 4096` on every request, regardless of the config value, and the response comes back with `finish_reason: length`. Calling the endpoint directly with curl and max_tokens 16000 works.

### Expected behavior

The configured max output tokens are passed to the endpoint.

### Workaround

Typing 'continue' makes it go on, but that breaks generated code files in the middle.

### Version / environment

Affects our data science team (6 users), who are the only ones using this model.

issues.title: Native iPhone and Android app for field staff
issues.body:
### What would you like?

A native app for iOS and Android, installable from the App Store and Google Play, with push notifications when an agent finishes a long task, and ideally voice input.

### Why

About 200 of our people are service technicians who are on the road all day and only have company phones. The web app works in Safari and Chrome on the phone, but they keep losing the tab, have to log in again through SSO more often than they like, and do not get notified when an answer is ready. A real app managed through our MDM (we use Intune) would make adoption much easier.

Is a mobile app planned?

issues.title: SCIM deactivation from Okta does not deactivate users in the workspace
issues.body:
### What happened?

SCIM provisioning from Okta creates new users fine (they show up within a few minutes), but deactivating does not work. 9 people who left the company in May were deactivated in Okta; Okta shows 'Push user deactivation: succeeded' for each of them. In our workspace they are still listed as Active under Admin > People and still count as paid seats.

They cannot actually sign in because Okta blocks them, so nobody got access they should not have, but we are paying for seats we should not.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Assign a test user to the app in Okta, wait for it to appear
2. Deactivate the user in Okta
3. User stays Active in the workspace

### Expected behavior

PATCH active=false from SCIM marks the user as deactivated and frees the seat.

We can deactivate them by hand in the admin UI for now.

issues.title: Let admins restrict which Slack channels the bot can join
issues.body:
### What would you like?

An admin setting for the Slack integration with an allowlist (or blocklist) of channels where the bot may be added and respond. If someone invites it to a channel that is not on the list it should politely refuse.

### Why

Anyone in our Slack can currently invite the bot to any channel, including #legal and #exec-private. The bot only sees what the agent has access to, so nothing is broken, but our compliance team wants control over where it is used before we open it to all 3,000 employees.

Right now we can only switch the whole integration on or off.

issues.title: Agent cites files from the HR collection to users outside the HR group
issues.body:
### What happened?

One of our sales reps asked the 'Sales Assistant' agent how commission is calculated. The answer cited 'Salary bands 2026.xlsx' and 'Bonus plan - leadership.pdf', both from our HR collection. That collection is restricted to the HR group in its sharing settings, and he is not in that group. The citation preview showed the actual figures.

We reproduced it with two other non-HR users the same day. The Sales Assistant agent only has the 'Sales playbook' collection attached, not the HR one.

### Expected behavior

Retrieval only returns documents from collections the agent is connected to and the user is allowed to see.

### What we did

We disabled the agent and removed the HR files from the library for now. We need to know since when this has been possible and who else could have seen these files.

issues.title: Can a workflow wait for a Jira issue to change status?
issues.body:
I have a workflow that creates a Jira issue for each new escalation from Zendesk. After that, I would like the same run to wait until the Jira issue moves to 'Done' and then post a summary back to the Zendesk ticket.

Is there a 'wait for event' kind of step that can do this? Or is the intended way to build a second workflow that starts from a Jira webhook and looks up the Zendesk ticket from a field in the issue?

If it's the second, is there a way to pass data between the two runs, or do I have to store the Zendesk ID in the Jira issue?

issues.title: Thanks for the onboarding session
issues.body:
Hi all,

Just a quick note, no action needed. The onboarding session your customer team ran for our department heads last Thursday was excellent. Everyone left with a working agent for their own team, and our usage doubled this week.

Special thanks to the person who stayed 40 minutes over time to help our finance lead with her invoice workflow. We will definitely book the advanced session in autumn.

Feel free to close this.

Cheers,
Tom

issues.title: API endpoint to export conversations for archiving
issues.body:
### What would you like?

A public API endpoint that lists conversations in the workspace (filterable by date and user) and returns the full messages, including attachment metadata and which agent or model answered.

### Why

We are a regulated financial services firm and must archive all business communication, including chats with AI assistants, in our archiving system for 7 years. Today we can only export a single chat as Markdown from the UI, which does not scale to 900 users.

An admin-scoped API key with read access to all conversations would be fine for us, with every export recorded in the audit log.

issues.title: Scheduled workflows stopped running for the whole workspace
issues.body:
### What happened?

None of our scheduled workflows have started since about 23:00 UTC yesterday (July 22). We have 31 scheduled workflows (hourly to daily). For all of them the run history ends at that time and the 'Next run' field shows a timestamp in the past, e.g. 'Next run: Jul 23, 06:00' when it is already 14:00.

Clicking 'Run now' starts them normally, and webhook-triggered workflows still run. Only the schedules are dead. Disabling and re-enabling the schedule did not help. Until yesterday this worked without problems.

### Impact

Our daily management reports and the hourly ticket routing depend on schedules. We are triggering the most important ones by hand, but that does not scale.

### Expected behavior

Scheduled runs start at their configured times.

issues.title: Nightly Salesforce sync did not run last night
issues.body:
Our 'Nightly Salesforce sync' workflow did not run last night, and the 06:00 'Morning pipeline digest' did not run this morning either. Both have run every day since February.

The schedule toggle is on for both. The workflows list says 'Last run: Jul 22' and there is no failed run in the history, they just never started. I did not change anything in either workflow.

Other people on my team say their scheduled stuff also did not go out today. Is the scheduler down? The sales team noticed because the pipeline numbers in Salesforce are a day old.

issues.title: Add an image generation model for marketing visuals
issues.body:
### What would you like?

An image generation model in the model picker, so we can ask for a product visual or a social media banner in a chat and get an image back. Even better if agents and workflows could use it too, e.g. a workflow that writes a blog post and creates a header image for it.

### Why

Our marketing team uses the app every day for copy, but for visuals they switch to a separate tool and paste the prompt over. Having text and images in one place would save time and keep our brand guidelines (which are in the knowledge library) in the loop.

Short video clips would be a nice next step, but images are the main thing.

issues.title: What happens when I upload a newer version of a document to a collection?
issues.body:
We update our travel policy PDF every quarter. When I upload the new version to the 'Company policies' collection, it appears as a second file next to the old one, both named 'Travel policy.pdf'.

Questions:

- Will answers cite both versions and possibly mix old and new rules?
- Is there a way to replace a file in place so the old version is no longer used?
- If I delete the old file, do existing chats that cited it break?

I can of course just delete the old one first, I mainly want to know what the recommended way is.

issues.title: Saving a workflow restored an old version and our recent changes are gone
issues.body:
### What happened?

I edited our 'Invoice intake' workflow: added two steps (a Jira lookup and a Teams notification) and rewrote the prompt in step 3. I clicked Save and got the green 'Workflow saved' toast. After reloading the page the workflow was back to a version from about three weeks ago.

It is not only my changes: the edits a colleague made last week (new extraction fields) are also gone. Version history shows that old version as the latest one, nothing newer.

The same thing happened to another workflow of ours on Aug 12, so this is the second time. As far as we can tell it only affects our ops team's workflows.

### Expected behavior

Saved changes stay saved, and every save appears in version history.

### Impact

About a day of work lost, and we are now afraid to edit any workflow.

issues.title: Downgrade to monthly billing and fewer seats at the end of our annual term
issues.body:
Hello,

Our annual Business subscription renews on October 31. Due to budget cuts we would like to:

1. Move from annual to monthly billing at renewal
2. Reduce from 60 to 35 seats at the same time

If monthly billing is not possible on the Business plan, we would rather cancel at the end of the term than renew for another year at 60 seats.

Can you confirm what we need to do before the renewal date, and whether reducing seats removes access for specific users or we choose who stays? We do not want the renewal to go through automatically in the meantime.

Thanks,
Jonas (IT procurement)

issues.title: Sharing a single chat without exposing my other chats
issues.body:
I want to share one conversation with a colleague so she can see how I got to a summary. When I click 'Share' I get a link, but I am not sure what she can see with it.

- Does the link only show this one conversation, or can she browse my history from there?
- If I keep chatting after sharing, does she see the new messages too?
- Can I revoke the link later?
- Can people outside our company open it if it gets forwarded?

I did not find this in the help center. Thanks!

issues.title: Typos in the getting started guide for admins
issues.body:
Small thing, no rush: the 'Getting started for admins' guide in the help center has a few typos.

- Step 2: 'recieve the invitation email' should be 'receive'
- Step 5: 'seperate collections' should be 'separate'
- The screenshot caption under step 6 says 'Worflows' instead of 'Workflows'

Everything in the product itself works fine, I just noticed this while onboarding a new colleague. Happy to send a full list if you want someone to proofread the other admin articles too.
